stories.headline: Upgrade is latest fintech to seek ILC charter
stories.body: Neobank Upgrade has applied for an industrial loan company charter, the latest nonbank financial firm to seek an unconventional bank charter as the administration pushes to bring more of the into the regulatory fold.
